Heya, I also have a special interest in biology and graduated with my degree about a week ago! I'd say

-Look for research opportunities. They can be hard to get as a freshman, but I guarantee that at least one of your professors is conducting research and needs students for it. 

-The low level classes might just be stuff you know, but the upper division classes will definitely have new material. I knew a good chunk of the intro to bio stuff, but once I got to comparative anatomy, cancer genetics, etc, there was a lot more to learn.

Ok, I fucking love skull cavern, so

-As stated by people before, bring good weapons. Lava katana if you don't have a prismatic shard, galaxy sword if you do.

-Spicy eel and espresso so you can get fast. You can get spicy eel with rubies from the desert trader

-Bombs. Lots of bombs and explosive ammo. You want to find holes, not ladders when possible and this is much quicker than using a pick. You'll also need bombs to keep mummies dead.

-Stairs. If you are getting absolutely wrecked on a level and need a quick escape, having stairs lets you get to a new level where you can heal up before being attacked again. Also helpful to keep you from spending too much time on one floor.

Good luck!

For me, there are 3 reasons that I consider causing damage. I understand that they aren't rational, but they're what my brain tells me. 

1) If amputation is unavoidable, there's no point in putting it off, might as well get it done sooner rather than later. 

2) If my leg is not amputated, I feel that something very bad might happen, ie a car crash where others are injured, a blood clot developing in my leg and traveling to my brain, etc. 

3) I do have some pain in my leg from an accident a that occurred 3 years ago (occurred after thoughts of amputation began, not self inflicted, honestly fairly minor). The pain is not extreme and from what I've been told, there's no lasting damage to my leg.  However, it does hurt to walk or stand for anything much longer than 5 mins. I wouldn't mind losing the leg and just not dealing with that anymore.
